install_cmds: python -c "import torch, numpy; print('torch', torch.__version__, 'numpy', numpy.__version__, 'cuda', torch.cuda.is_available())"

data_deps.name: inr_signal_fitting_kodak
data_deps.description: Three real Kodak reference photos (kodim10/kodim07/kodim13, center-cropped to 256x256) baked into fixed {low,medium,high}.npz coordinate/target tensors. Selection uses the minimum and maximum Laplacian-variance crops as endpoints and the remaining crop nearest their joint log-space midpoint in Laplacian variance and radial-FFT high-frequency fraction. Array digests pin the exact anchored pixels. Replaces prior synthetic targets; approximately 7.5 MB and deterministic.
